claims.text: Tác phẩm có thật, tên: Eichmann in Jerusalem (Eichmann in Jerusalem: A Report on the Banality of Evil)

sources.quote: [EJ] Eichmann in Jerusalem: A Report on the Banality of Evil. New York: Viking Press, 1963
In 1961 she attended the trial of Adolf Eichmann in Jerusalem as a reporter for The New Yorker magazine, and two years later published Eichmann in Jerusalem
Eichmann in Jerusalem: A Report on the Banality of Evil. New York: Viking Press, 1963. Revised and enlarged edition, 1965

notes: attribution: Hannah Arendt. trung-voi: arendt.eichmann-in-jerusalem-a-report-on-the-banality-of. Bản sửa và bổ sung 1965.
